name: deCluttered.ai
tagline: Scan a room and an agent prices your clutter, writes the listings and answers buyers.

awards: Best Deployment on Agentverse Presented by Fetch.Ai

problem: Reselling unused items is too much work, so they pile up.
solution: Detects items in a room scan, sorts resellable ones, sets prices, generates listings, answers buyer questions by email and surfaces the best offers; deployed on an agent platform.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan a room and get listings ready to post.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Deployment on Agentverse Presented by Fetch.Ai” among 122 submissions.
Covers the whole path from clutter to cash.

lessons: Automate the tedious middle steps users quit on.
